_doc: The sound of a strike (game/audio/thunder.gd). sound_ms: the speed of sound in air at 20 °C, 343 m/s. Brown noise is a leaky random walk: step, keep and gain set its level; noise_s seconds kept, one buffer for every clap; a clap starts somewhere in the first start_share of it. A strike's delay is capped at max_delay_s; near_m the distance at which its nearness is 1/2; the low-pass runs from cutoff_low_hz, plus cutoff_span_hz by nearness squared (a near strike keeps its crack, far off only the low roll arrives); its level from far_gain to far_gain + near_gain by nearness, never under floor_db.
